name: LangGraph Agent (JS)
description: A LangGraph.js graph served over the Agents Hub HTTP contract. The graph stays in its own repository and is not modified: the adapter loads it by AGENTHUB_GRAPH, translates LangGraph's own stream events into hub frames, and continues a graph that stopped to ask a person.

env.name: AGENTHUB_GRAPH
env.description: The graph to serve, as module:export, the same spelling langgraph.json uses for a JS project. Example: ./src/agent.js:graph. Bundled: ./demo_graph.js:graph, or ./approval_graph.js:graph for one that stops to ask a person.

env.name: AGENTHUB_INPUT_KEY
env.description: State key the prompt enters through. Defaults to 'messages', which suits any graph built on MessagesAnnotation. A graph with a custom state names its own key and receives the prompt as that key's string value.

env.name: AGENTHUB_OUTPUT_KEY
env.description: State key the answer is read from. Defaults to the input key, which is right for message graphs.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Only what the graph itself needs. The hub never supplies the graph's model access; the graph keeps its own.

tools: whatever the graph binds to its own nodes
